caption:
"I've already done three courses." I believe you — and I'd bet you can explain liquidity better than half the people currently profitable.

A course transfers information. It was never built to be there at 3pm on a Thursday when you're about to move your stop for the second time. Nobody has ever moved a stop because they forgot what a stop was for.

The technical part of this is smaller than any course you've bought. What's bigger is someone looking at the trades you actually took. Five per month.
